historical_diffusion_reference.note: These diffusion runs use their native generation budget and are context rather than a matched decoding comparison.

interpretation: DiffusionGemma's causal encoder and tied language-model head support coherent autoregressive generation even though Transformers exposes only the block-diffusion generator.
Native AR reaches 51/64, below the historical 59/64 native-diffusion score but clearly far above a nonfunctional auxiliary objective.
On matched AR settings, LOD loses 13 examples relative to native attention, despite having no diffusion acceptance, canvas decoder, or decoder routing in the generation path.
The AR result localizes the additional LOD failure to approximate attention in the causal encoder path, including prompt prefill and incremental AR decoding.
Legacy top-8 prefill does not recover the matched 16-example subset, so the optimized top-3 prefill budget alone does not explain the regression.
Native AR changes from 48/64 to 51/64 across batch and generation-budget settings, so only the matched 51-versus-38 comparison should be treated as the clean LOD effect.
